scope: Public VM cleanup composition: foreign admission, registry leases, active cohort and retained joins. Not full GC or native acceptance.

cases.scope: One exclusive cleanup owner with joined direct users; source permits foreign-free but active or pending-join cohorts to reach destruction. Positive rejects those requests while retaining resources, closes foreign admission before registry draining, then releases resources and memory. Rejection is not counted as successful teardown. Existing reader leases may leave; no concurrent constructor/resize owner, hardware memory-model proof, native ABI refinement or full GC is asserted.
